age.evidence: Upon arrival, rats were approximately 10 weeks of age and weighed between 175 and 200 grams.

sex.evidence: Each of the seven studies was conducted in an independent group of adult male Long Evans rats (n = 12/group, n = 84 total)

psychedelic: Psilocybin, DMT, (±)-DOI (comparators: lisuride, ketamine, fluoxetine; antagonist volinanserin)

dosing.evidence: Psilocybin, ketamine, DMT, (±)-DOI, lisuride, and fluoxetine were dissolved in 0.9% saline solution... All drugs were delivered subcutaneously... psilocybin 0.1-1.0 mg/kg, 1 hr pretreatment
DMT fumarate... dissolved in 0.9% saline solution. All drugs were delivered subcutaneously... DMT 1-10 mg/kg, 20 min pretreatment
(±)-DOI... dissolved in 0.9% saline solution. All drugs were delivered subcutaneously... (±)-DOI 0.3-3 mg/kg, 1 hr pretreatment
Lisuride maleate... dissolved in 0.9% saline solution. All drugs were delivered subcutaneously... lisuride 0.1-1 mg/kg, 1 hour pretreatment
Ketamine hydrochloride... dissolved in 0.9% saline solution. All drugs were delivered subcutaneously... ketamine 10 mg/kg, 2 hour pretreatment
fluoxetine 0.3-3 mg/kg, 1 hour pretreatment (Fig. 4 legend states 30 minutes for fluoxetine). All drugs were delivered subcutaneously.

dosing.doses_raw: volinanserin (0.03-0.3 mg/kg) 15 minutes prior to 1 mg/kg psilocybin
dosing.evidence: Volinanserin was dissolved in a vehicle comprised of 30% DMSO and 70% saline. All drugs were delivered subcutaneously... Antagonism studies were conducted by administering volinanserin (0.03-0.3 mg/kg) 15 minutes prior to 1 mg/kg psilocybin

group_housing.evidence: They were group-housed 3 to a home cage with unrestricted access to water

day_night_flipped.evidence: climate-controlled vivarium with a 12-h light/dark cycle (lights on at 7 am)

assays.assay_description: Touchscreen operant task in a custom Plexiglas chamber (25x30x35 cm) in a sound/light-attenuating enclosure; rats discriminate long vs short lines, with a 3:1 rich/lean probabilistic reinforcement schedule (sweetened condensed milk). 100-trial sessions (~20-30 min). Measures response bias (log b), discriminability (log d) and reaction time. Seven independent cohorts (n=12 each) tested psilocybin, DMT, (±)-DOI, lisuride, ketamine, fluoxetine and volinanserin pretreatment in within-subject Latin-square designs at acute, 24 h and (psilocybin/ketamine) 7-day timepoints.

setup_habituation.evidence: modified response-shaping techniques were used to train rats to engage with the touchscreen... Following PRT line-length discrimination training, drug testing was conducted.

setup_restrain.evidence: train rats to engage with the touchscreen by rearing on their hind legs and using their paw to make a touchscreen response

food_restriction.evidence: To establish sweetened condensed milk as a reinforcer, rats were restricted to approximately 10-15 g of rodent chow... given daily after the experimental session.

water_restriction.evidence: unrestricted access to water (home cage); no water source described in the testing chamber (only sweetened condensed milk reward receptacle)

time_to_assay.evidence: DMT 20 min, psilocybin/DOI/lisuride/fluoxetine 1 hr, ketamine 2 hr pretreatment; 'PRT performance was also evaluated on Friday to examine drug effects 24 hours post-administration'; psilocybin/ketamine study also tested '7-day post dosing'

sample_size.evidence: adult male Long Evans rats (n = 12/group, n = 84 total); Fig. 1 table lists n=12 for each of Studies 1-7

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (peak 1 mg/kg) and ketamine (10 mg/kg) increased PRT response bias (log b) acutely and at 24 h, returning to vehicle levels by 7 days; volinanserin dose-dependently blocked psilocybin's but not ketamine's effect. DMT and (±)-DOI produced acute dose-dependent increases in response bias not sustained at 24 h; DOI also increased reaction time and trended toward reduced discriminability. Lisuride decreased response bias at 0.1 mg/kg and increased reaction time; fluoxetine had no effect.
outcomes.evidence: Reward responsiveness was significantly increased following administration of psilocybin (0.1-1 mg/kg) or ketamine (10 mg/kg) acutely, and the effect persisted 24 hours after dosing... Both... DMT (1-10 mg/kg) and... (±)-DOI (0.3-3 mg/kg) produced significant dose-related increases in reward responsiveness acutely; however, these effects were not sustained 24 hours later.

B1_num_measures.evidence: two primary dependent measures: Response Bias (log b) and Task Discriminability (log d)... Reaction time during PRT performance was also calculated

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Session-level log b/log d and RT averaged across trials; acute/24h/7d are between-session comparisons

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transition, sequence or bout analysis reported

B5_social.evidence: Non-social operant task; rat tested alone in the chamber

B6_cognitive.evidence: The PRT is an RDoC-recommended task for studying positive valence, specifically the subdomain of reinforcement learning

B7_automated_classification.evidence: All experimental events were programmed in E-Prime Professional 2.0 (touchscreen responses, no behavioural classification)

B8_multivariate.evidence: PRT outcomes... were subject to one-way repeated measures analysis of variance (ANOVA)

E1_environment_type.evidence: a custom-built Plexiglas chamber (25x30x35 cm) was situated in a sound- and light-attenuating enclosure

E2_shelter.evidence: Apparatus described as Plexiglas chamber with touchscreen and reward receptacle; no shelter

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects described in operant chamber

E6_spatial.evidence: custom-built Plexiglas chamber (25x30x35 cm) — single compartment

E7_social_context.evidence: Single-subject operant chamber; no conspecific present during recording

E8_food_water.evidence: An infusion pump... was used to deliver sweetened condensed milk solution into the reservoir of an aluminum receptacle... Each response was reinforced with 0.1 mL of 30% sweetened condensed milk

D1_continuity.evidence: Drug or vehicle doses were administered on Thursday... PRT performance was also evaluated on Friday to examine drug effects 24 hours post-administration... a second 5-session testing condition was included to determine PRT outcomes 7-day post dosing

D2_session_duration.evidence: weekly 100-trial testing sessions (Monday-Friday) that took approximately 20-30 minutes to complete

D3_recording_days.evidence: within-subjects design... vehicle and drug doses were studied across PRT test weeks... using a Latin square counterbalanced treatment order (e.g., Study 1: 5 treatment conditions × acute + 24h days, plus 7-day testing condition)

D4_baseline.evidence: Monday/Tuesday training sessions were used only to designate the lean stimulus; no pre-drug PRT baseline outcome data reported (vehicle used as comparator)

D5_followup.evidence: PRT performance was also evaluated on Friday to examine drug effects 24 hours post-administration

D6_circadian.evidence: sessions took approximately 20-30 minutes to complete

judge_notes: All candidates agreed on a single assay (PRT); the seven drug studies, volinanserin antagonism and timepoints were collapsed into one assay per rubric.
B1 set to 1 (2-3 measures: log b, log d, RT); gemma's score of 2 was inconsistent with its own '2-3' category.
E8 scored Yes (modal 2/3): sweetened condensed milk reward delivered into in-chamber receptacle during the session.

D3 set to 15+: within-subject Latin square across multiple weekly test weeks with acute and 24h sessions each (Study 1 alone yields ≥15 recording days including 7-day condition); medium confidence because exact count not stated.
D4 kept at 0 (modal): Monday/Tuesday training data used only for lean-stimulus assignment, not reported as a baseline outcome.

food_restriction set to 'before' overriding modal 'no': paper explicitly states chow restriction given after sessions to establish the milk reinforcer (rubric example for pre-operant weight restriction).
water_restriction set to 'during' per rubric (no water source in chamber; water ad lib only in home cage).
Corrected qwen's outcome summary, which incorrectly stated psilocybin effects persisted at 7 days; paper reports return to vehicle levels by day 7.
Dosing includes all administered compounds (psychedelics and comparators); fluoxetine pretreatment discrepancy (1 h in Methods vs 30 min in Fig. 4) noted.
